faqs.q: What types of videos does Kinetic Studio edit?
faqs.a: We specialize in high-retention video editing across two primary formats: YouTube longform (talking heads, video podcasts, deep-dive documentaries, and educational content) and vertical shortform (Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and TikToks). Every edit includes pacing optimization, motion graphics, audio mastering, and thumbnail packaging.

faqs.q: How does custom pricing and monthly retainers work?
faqs.a: We do not believe in rigid, one-size-fits-all packages. On our initial call, we look at your current publishing schedule, average raw footage length, and desired motion graphics complexity. We then build a flat, predictable monthly retainer or per-project quote tailored to your exact monthly output.

faqs.q: What editing software and post-production tools do you use?
faqs.a: Our team works inside industry-standard professional suites: Adobe Premiere Pro for core assembly and narrative pacing, Adobe After Effects for bespoke motion graphics and kinetic typography, DaVinci Resolve for cinematic color grading, and Adobe Audition / iZotope for audio cleanup and sound design.

faqs.q: What is your typical turnaround time?
faqs.a: For vertical shortform batches, our typical turnaround is 48 hours. For YouTube longform videos (10–20 minutes), initial cuts are delivered within 48 to 72 hours. Once we establish your brand style guide and ongoing rhythm, deliveries become completely predictable and synchronized with your upload calendar.

We use Frame.io / async video review tools where you or your team can click and leave timestamped comments and visual draw-overs directly on the video player. We offer fast 24-48 hour revision turnarounds until you are 100% happy with the final cut.

faqs.q: How do we send you our raw footage?
faqs.a: You can upload raw camera footage, audio tracks, and assets directly to Google Drive, Dropbox, Frame.io, or your existing cloud storage. We can also provide a dedicated shared cloud folder structured for effortless weekly file transfers.

faqs.q: Do you provide custom thumbnails and motion graphics?
faqs.a: Yes. A great video edit is wasted without high click-through rates. We provide custom high-CTR YouTube thumbnails (with 2 visual concepts per video) and custom motion graphics (kinetic titles, lower-thirds, animated icons, and sound design) as part of our core editing service.

faqs.q: Can we do a test edit before committing to a monthly retainer?
faqs.a: Absolutely. We offer a paid single-video trial edit so you can test our pacing, motion graphics quality, communication, and turnaround speed with zero long-term commitment. If it's a great fit, we transition smoothly into an ongoing monthly retainer.

You get a dedicated private Slack channel with Nafew and our senior video editors. No cumbersome ticketing systems or slow email chains. You have a direct line to your editors for asset drops, style notes, feedback, and quick questions.

faqs.q: Can you repurpose longform YouTube videos into vertical shortform?
faqs.a: Yes. Our Omnichannel Video Retainer is specifically engineered for this. We analyze your longform video, identify the most engaging moments and strongest hooks, and re-edit them into standalone vertical Reels, Shorts, and TikToks with kinetic typography and audio effects.
